source: MAFF / ADB, "ដំណាំសណ្តែកសៀង" [Soybean crop], official cultivation manual, 2005
text: Two sowing methods are described: dibbling (planting seed into individual holes at fixed spacing) and row sowing (drilling seed along furrows). Recommended row and in-row spacing are given for the manual's two growth-habit types, along with seeding-rate guidance, and an herbicide product (Alachlor) is named for pre-emergence weed control alongside manual weeding as an alternative for farmers without herbicide access.
